notes.title: THE HOUSE OF THE DEAD: Remake - now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Traverse the grotesque mansion once more and behold the Curien's masterpiece!

• Well known arcade classic with modern graphics and controls, including gyro aiming
• True to the original gameplay
• Local 2-player multiplayer
• Multiple endings
• Photomode
• Achievements
• Armory with unlockable weapons
• Hordes of the undead monstrosities in a new game mode
• Gallery with encountered enemies and bosses

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1694600/THE_HOUSE_OF_THE_DEAD_Remake/

notes.title: Fred3ric is coming to Steam on May 15th!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11464454/a9809ab9f3acc9506231230e341615ef503d2a86.jpg[/img]

[h1]Frederic is back![/h1]
The continuation of FE's classic, story-driven rhythm games, with epic musical battles against well-know composers will be available on Steam starting [b]May 15th![/b]

The third game from the series includes even more great music and all those elements you loved in the previous Frederic games. Once again, stand against the Evil and fight the infected, steel-bound great composers of bygone times!

[b]Skills and piano are the only things our hero has left - will it be enough this time?[/b]

notes.title: We are the Plague - Patch #1 is now live!
notes.content:

A new patch for We are the Plague on Steam is now live! We've listened to your feedback and the first batch of fixes and improvements is waiting for you - make sure your game is up to date!

PATCH NOTE:
- No more camping guys! Now the chance for a counter-attack when defending is lowered to 30% (previously 100%)
- Any collectors here? We added achievements for you!

- Added some minor bug fixes

notes.title: Another Update!
notes.content:
What was fixed.
- windows executable is 32bit and now work on both 32 and 64 bit systems.
- "Nothing personal" achievement fixed, achieved only when you win with Chopin or Funky Chopin.
- multiplayer help added, check avatar description for short information about ranking system.
- multiplayer stability fixes
- auto search games button every 20 seconds unless paused
- when both player are connected timer kicks in, leaving 30 seconds for duel setup. After time runs out game automatically starts.
- similar timeout is introduced on multiplayer summary popup, automatically selects next level after 20 seconds
- bollywood stage fixed in multiplayer

notes.title: Bugs, Bugs everywhere!!!
notes.content:
- audio fixes
- options menu now works as intended
- bonus note needs to be clicked not only hover over
- multiplier help message shows whole text
- fixed unlocking arenas and score display
- gnome in Ireland has partial invisibility spell taken off
- introduced explanation for single player total score, 
  total score = base score * multiplier, where multiplier is based on difficulty:
  0.8, 1, 1.2, 1.5 consecutively for easy, normal, hard an chopin
